title.en: old things market at bazar na kole.
title.tr: bazar na kole'de eski eşya pazarı.

line.en: sunday old-things market in the wola district, obozowa 99. free entry, trams 12, 13 or 24 to dalibora. the busy part is the morning, so go early.
line.de: sonntäglicher trödelmarkt im stadtteil wola, obozowa 99. eintritt frei, straßenbahn 12, 13 oder 24 bis dalibora. das meiste passiert am morgen, also früh hin.
line.tr: pazar günü wola bölgesinde, obozowa 99'da eski eşya pazarı. giriş ücretsiz, 12, 13 ya da 24 numaralı tramvayla dalibora durağına. en yoğun saatler sabah.

sparks.why: Bazar na Kole, Obozowa 99, open every Saturday and Sunday per In Your Pocket and other Warsaw listings; hours differ by source (about 6:00-15:00 or 8:00-15:00), so 08:00 is a suggestion. No special November 2026 notice found.
